stack.cicd: manual local signed release, notarization, and independent verification; no GitHub Actions workflow

environments.prod: tailnet-only Tailscale Serve route /kltimage-preview, proxied to 127.0.0.1:8786

deploymentTarget: versioned macOS ZIPs over the existing tailnet-only Tailscale Serve route

deployment.releasePolicy: publish each approved build at a distinct versioned path and update advertised links only after the served bytes pass independent release verification
deployment.rollback: restore the pre-deployment source-only guidance and remove only the failed new build; preserve Build 3 unchanged but do not advertise it as trusted
